_note: Higgsfield credits per call, read by pipeline/hooks/spend_guard.py to price a generation before it is sent. per_image: credits per image (times count). per_second: credits per requested second by resolution (video is billed per whole requested second). per_call: a flat price. Sources: CLAUDE.md, formats/creator.md, work/sk03/credits.md. A model missing here is blocked until its price is added: run the same call with get_cost true (free), then python3 pipeline/spend.py price MODEL CREDITS --per image|second|call [--resolution 720p].
